purpose: Verified issuer press releases and company investor-relations updates matched to exact NCT for Phase 3 endpoint and supporting safety/regulatory facts
scope: Official issuer announcements cross-linked by exact NCT, study code, drug and indication; not independently verified FDA approval or calibrated trading predictions.

records.regulatory: Company intended NDA submission late Q4 2026; not proof of submission or FDA acceptance.

records.specificEvidence: Sponsor reported both 6- and 12-week continuous abstinence primary comparisons met versus placebo: 25.3% vs 4.4%, and 32.6% vs 7.0%, respectively; both p<0.0001.

records.regulatory: Achieve announced a June 22, 2026 FDA cytisinicline NDA Complete Response Letter citing third-party manufacturing and labeling, with no clinical efficacy or safety deficiencies identified. A regulatory CRL is not a Phase 3 endpoint failure.
records.crosswalk: JAMA 2023 trial publication PMID 37432430 explicitly identifies ORCA-2 as NCT04576949; official sponsor release identifies ORCA-2.

records.specificEvidence: Sponsor reported primary continuous smoking abstinence significantly higher than placebo: 14.8% vs 6.0% for 6-week treatment (p=0.0008), and 30.3% vs 9.4% for 12-week treatment (p<0.0001).

records.specificEvidence: Sponsor reported adjunctive pimavanserin missed the prespecified full-population primary PANSS total score change at week 6 (p=0.0940). Exploratory/regional positive findings do not change primary endpoint FAIL.
records.safetyEvidence: Company characterized tolerability as consistent with prior studies; this is not a quantitative safety determination.
records.regulatory: The clinical efficacy endpoint was not met in ENHANCE-1. FDA application or PDUFA outcome is not inferred.
records.crosswalk: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT02970292 identifies ENHANCE-1 protocol ACP-103-034 (396 participants); sponsor July 22, 2019 release identifies the same 396-person study.

records.specificEvidence: Sponsor reported the week-26 Negative Symptom Assessment-16 primary endpoint did not reach statistical significance: change -11.8 pimavanserin vs -11.1 placebo, p=0.4825. Independent peer-reviewed ADVANCE-2 analysis PMID 40181715 reports P=.48.
records.safetyEvidence: Sponsor reported a similar tolerability profile to earlier studies; the peer-reviewed report described 30.4% and 40.3% treatment-emergent adverse-event rates for pimavanserin and placebo, respectively.
records.regulatory: Failed clinical primary endpoint is distinct from any FDA application decision.
records.crosswalk: EudraCT 2019-003343-29 links ADVANCE-2 and protocol ACP-103-064 to NCT04531982; ClinicalTrials.gov protocol for NCT04531982 gives the same study and endpoint.

records.specificEvidence: In the prespecified randomized withdrawal phase, time to psychosis relapse was improved: 12 of 95 (13%) continued pimavanserin vs 28 of 99 (28%) switched to placebo; hazard ratio 0.35 (95% CI 0.17–0.73), two-sided p=0.005. Trial stopped early at prespecified efficacy interim analysis.
records.safetyEvidence: Double-blind adverse events occurred in 41.0% on pimavanserin and 36.6% on placebo. This efficacy result applies to prior responders in the randomized-withdrawal trial, not all dementia patients.
records.regulatory: Prespecified clinical primary endpoint met; not evidence that a dementia-related psychosis label was FDA-approved.
records.crosswalk: NEJM primary report DOI 10.1056/NEJMoa2034634 and PMID 34289275 identify HARMONY as NCT03325556.

records.specificEvidence: Week-5 weekly cataplexy frequency primary endpoint met vs placebo: rate ratio 0.49, p=0.018. Key secondary endpoints included FOSQ-10 cognitive-function score p=0.004 and CGI-S daytime sleepiness p=0.027; the FOSQ-10 is a patient-reported function/quality-of-life instrument.
records.safetyEvidence: In SYMPHONY, AXS-12 treatment adverse events included dry mouth (n=6), nausea (n=6), and constipation (n=4), primarily mild to moderate; AE discontinuations n=1 in each treatment group; no serious adverse events were reported.
records.regulatory: 2026-11-02 issuer results describe AXS-12 NDA under FDA review with PDUFA target action date May 1, 2027 for cataplexy in narcolepsy. This applies to the drug/indication application, not an individual trial.
records.crosswalk: NCT05059223 is SYMPHONY Phase 3 narcolepsy study; distinct from ENCORE.
records.regulatoryEvidence: Axsome investor relations November 2, 2026 reports FDA NDA review for AXS-12/reboxetine for cataplexy in narcolepsy with May 1, 2027 PDUFA target action date. Both SYMPHONY and ENCORE are supporting Phase 3 studies; no FDA outcome has occurred.

records.specificEvidence: Randomized-withdrawal primary week-3 cataplexy frequency increase: 1.32 attacks/week on continued AXS-12 vs 10.29 on placebo withdrawal, p=0.017 (42 randomized). Secondary endpoints included cognition and excessive daytime sleepiness; patient-reported PGI-C overall narcolepsy improvement and work-productivity assessments were recorded in the sponsor release.
records.safetyEvidence: ENCORE six-month open-label safety: nausea 5.9%, tachycardia 5.9%; AE discontinuations 17.6% of 68 participants. In double blind: treatment-related AEs 4.5% continued AXS-12 versus 15.0% placebo; no new safety signal identified.
records.regulatory: 2026-11-02 issuer results describe AXS-12 NDA under FDA review with PDUFA target action date May 1, 2027 for cataplexy in narcolepsy. Drug/indication application-level milestone, not trial-specific approval.
records.crosswalk: NCT05113745 is ENCORE long-term randomized withdrawal Phase 3; not SYMPHONY.
records.regulatoryEvidence: Axsome investor relations November 2, 2026 reports FDA NDA review for AXS-12/reboxetine for cataplexy in narcolepsy with May 1, 2027 PDUFA target action date. Both SYMPHONY and ENCORE are supporting Phase 3 studies; no FDA outcome has occurred.

regulatoryApplicationScope: Eight trial-to-application links for three separate drug/indication FDA programs. Trials and FDA approvals are not one-to-one: ADVANCE-2 failed efficacy although the AXS-05 program received FDA approval. Historical 2022/2026 dates are not upcoming PDUFA catalysts.
